test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Numerical Ability (Held on: 03 Dec, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: The radius of a giant metal spherical ball is 12 cm. Its outer surface is required to be painted. What will be the cost of the painting at the rate of Rs. 7 per cm² (Approximate to the nearest integer) (Take π = (22)/(7))
solution:
**Given:**

Radius (r) = 12 cm

Cost of painting per cm² = ₹7

**Formula used:**

Surface area of a sphere = 4πr²

**Calculations:**

Surface area = 4 × (22/7) × 12²

⇒ Surface area = 4 × (22/7) × 144

⇒ Surface area = 4 × 22 × 144 / 7

⇒ Surface area = 12672 / 7

⇒ Surface area ≈ 1810 cm²

Cost = 1810 × 7

⇒ Cost ≈ ₹12,672

**∴ The correct answer is option 1.**
